portfolio.description: Balanced: equal-weight top-3 persona-fleets (deepseek_v4, deepseek_r1, gpt4o). Diversifies across providers.
portfolio.methodology: Aggregated from ai_tournament_picks_latest.json (resolved WIN/LOSS/TP_HIT/SL_HIT). Eligibility gate: n>=20, WR>=50%, PF>=1.1. Reliability scored by composite = 0.5*Wilson95LB(WR) + 0.3*PF_LB/3 + 0.2*(1-exp(-n/50)). Position weights synthesize paper allocations against $100k starting NAV. NOT promoted to live money; tracked as shadow paper only per CLAUDE.md Goal #1. Variant: top-3 equal-weighted; each fleet's picks equal-weighted within its 33.3% sleeve.
